Love this video? We’ve got even more for you to enjoy on the Premier League App
There's nothing quite like a last-ditch tackle. Strikers through on goal, everyone in the stands expecting the ball to hit the back of the net. Until these heroic defenders come up clutch to make a crucial tackle, stopping a certain goal! Here we have over 50 moments where the defenders have done just that, including impressive interventions from Liverpool's Jeremy Jacquet, Chelsea's Reece James, Spurs' Micky van de Ven, Arsenal's Ezri Konsa, and many more!
